title: Air-Path Kit by the Air Path's Days in Service — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Air-Path Kit by the Air Path's Days in Service — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Records standard.** The internal air-path kit a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit takes when it comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request is chosen by a day count that starts from the latest event that put a fresh air path in the unit and runs to the date the completed return pickup request records the unit as received back:

1. on a unit with a **manufacturer-warranty repair** on its device record, the days are counted from the service date of the latest such repair;
2. on a unit with no such repair that was **shipped for a virtual setup**, they are counted from the transaction date on its sale line, the date the sale was paid and the unit left the warehouse;
3. on any other unit, they are counted from the delivery date on the device record.

The lines are read in that order: a warranty repair on the record decides the start whatever the hand-over was. The air-path kit tiers apply to that count:

| Days in service at receipt | Air-path kit | List price (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| more than 14 | full air-path kit | 18.00 |
| more than 7 and up to 14 | half kit | 9.00 |
| 7 or less | none | 0.00 |

**Where each date is read.** The warranty repair is a repair job in the device's service history whose cost was borne under the manufacturer warranty; the hand-over is the delivery mode on the delivery in that history (the latest, where there is more than one); the transaction date is the date the sale line in the device's billing history records the sale as paid; the delivery date is on the device record; the receipt date is the decision date of the completed return pickup request. Days are calendar days from the start date to the receipt date, the start date itself not counted.

## Start date by record

| Manufacturer-warranty repair on the record | Hand-over at delivery | Days counted from |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | the latest warranty repair's service date |
| no | virtual setup (shipped) | the transaction date on the sale line |
| no | in-home, branch or courier | the delivery date |

**Example (hypothetical dates).** A unit whose sale was paid on 1 March, shipped for a virtual setup and delivered on 4 March, is received back on 20 March with no warranty repair: 19 days from the transaction date, full air-path kit at 18.00. Had a warranty repair been completed on 12 March, the count would run from 12 March, 8 days, and the unit would take the half kit at 9.00.
